tagline: Know your headers. Own your security.
value_proposition: HeaderGuard gives developers and security engineers instant HTTP security header analysis plus continuous real-time monitoring with regression alerts — so header misconfigurations are caught before attackers find them, not after.
target_audience: Security engineers at SaaS startups and scale-ups
Backend developers who own deployment pipelines
DevOps and platform engineers running CI/CD systems
CTOs preparing for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits
Freelance developers conducting security reviews for clients
Agencies building web applications for regulated industries
pain_points: Developers forget to set security headers after refactors or framework upgrades
Free scanners (SecurityHeaders.com, Mozilla Observatory) are one-shot tools with no monitoring
Header regressions after deployments go undetected for days or weeks
Security audit checklists are manual and not integrated into the development workflow
Remediation guidance from existing tools is vague and not framework-specific
Sharing scan results with non-technical stakeholders requires manual report generation
key_features: Instant HTTP security header scan for any public URL
A-F header score with per-header pass/fail breakdown
Real-time monitoring with deployment regression detection
Slack and email alerts when headers change or degrade
90-day header score history and trend charts
Copy-paste remediation code snippets per framework (Next.js, Express, Nginx, Caddy)
API access for CI/CD integration (Pro/Team tier)
Bulk URL scanning for agencies managing multiple client sites
CyberOS integration for unified security dashboard
competitive_advantages: Only free-tier tool with continuous monitoring (not just one-shot scans)
Framework-specific remediation snippets (Next.js headers config, Nginx directives)
Integrated into the Veridux Labs security ecosystem via CyberOS
Deployment regression alerts — triggered by header changes, not just score thresholds
Developer-native UI with raw header inspection and cURL equivalents
API-first architecture enables CI/CD gate integration at Pro tier
